BY THE PP, ASSAM Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. S ALIM Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  Page No.# 2/4  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MITALI THAKURIA  ORDER 22.03.2023 Heard Mr. S. Alim, learned counsel for the applicant.
Also heard Mr. D. Das, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.

This is an application filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, praying for grant of pre-arrest bail to the applicant in connection with BIEO P.C. Case No.15/2022, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/406 of the Indian penal Code.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. S. Alim, that accused/applicant is no way involved in the alleged offence.

He also submitted that upon execution of agreement for sale of the land, the informant entrusted the present accused/applicant to obtain sale permission N.O.C.

sentences.text: Further, due to rainy season as well as shifting of the office of the Circle Office, the said permission cannot be obtained.

In the meantime,
the informant also tried to contact the co-accused namely Sahil Hussain in this regard, but, he could not make any contact with him and thereafter, receiving the notice from the IO, he appeared before the IO by producing some documents.

Further, the learned counsel for the applicant is still ready to co-operate with the investigation of this case and accordingly, he prays for interim protection in the form of interim pre-arrest bail.
In this context, Mr. D. Das, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has Page No.# 3/4 submitted that the case diary may be required to reveal the facts of this case.
Accordingly, he has not raised objections on the prayer made by the accused/applicant.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsels of both sides and also considering the aspect of the matter, I find it a fit case to grant the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the accused/applicant till receipt of the case diary.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the accused/applicant, namely, Shri Moinul Hoque Ansari, in connection with BIEO P.C. Case No.15/2022, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/406 of the Indian penal Code, he shall be enlarged on pre-arrest bail on his executing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) only with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the following conditions:
(i) that the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer as and when required.
(ii) that the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and (iii) that the applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the concerned jurisdictional Magistrate, without prior permission.
In the meanwhile the C/D is to be called for.
Page No.# 4/4 List the matter on 28.04.2023.
